odvs.description: win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age is the policy setting that determines the maximum allowable age for a computer account password. By default, domain members automatically change their domain passwords every 30 days. The recommended state for this setting is: 30 or fewer days, but not 0.
odvs.name: domain_member_maximum_password_age

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.6.5 | PATCH | Ensure Domain member Maximum machine account password age is set to 30 or fewer days but not 0"
  when: win25cis_rule_2_3_6_5
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.6.5
    - patch
    - account
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "2.3.6.5 | PATCH | Ensure Domain member Maximum machine account password age is set to 30 or fewer days but not 0 | Apply Settings To Registry"
      when:
        - win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age <= 30
        - win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age > 0
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\Parameters
        name: MaximumPasswordAge
        data: "{{ win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "2.3.6.5 | AUDIT | Ensure Domain member Maximum machine account password age is set to 30 or fewer days but not 0 | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when:
        - win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age > 30 or
          win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age == 0
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of days set for win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.6.5 | AUDIT | Ensure Domain member Maximum machine account password age is set to 30 or fewer days but not 0 | Warn Count"
      when:
        - win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age > 30 or
          win25cis_domain_member_maximum_password_age == 0
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.6.5'
